name: channel-list
title: Channel List
usage: <ChannelList workspace="Studio" channels={[{ id: "design", name: "design", kind: "channel", topic: "Review" }]} />
useCases: In a course sidebar, a student selects their cohort’s channel. The app opens the conversation by its stable ID.
In team chat, a colleague switches from a shared channel to a direct conversation. The list highlights the selection controlled by the app.
behavior: Use a stable ID per channel. Pass value and update it from onSelect to synchronize navigation with the displayed conversation.
